note: Per-module first-party/vendor decision. esbuild emits one __export block per source module, so this is a structural fact about the bundle, not a guess from names. A block is matched to a record when 2 of its 3 marker names are present, which tolerates exports being added or removed between releases. A block matching neither list stops the build: a new upstream module is one decision, not N unknown names.

firstParty.note: launchd service management. v0.8.2 dropped getRunAtLoad/setRunAtLoad with the `daemon enable-autostart`/`disable-autostart` verbs; the three markers are untouched, so the record still matches.
job subcommand (new in v0.8.2). `duoduo job list|read|archive|interrupt|reschedule` — the job lifecycle verbs ManageJob gave up, moved to the shell as operator actions.
